stage0004_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$さやか$$
「A Mechanical Beast!
　So there were more of them left!」

stage0004_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$甲児$$
「Then $$マジンガーＺ$$ will just have to smash it flat!」

stage0004_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Wait, $$甲児$$!
　Look at the capsule in that beast's body!」

stage0004_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Damn it!
　Let me out! Let me out!!」

stage0004_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スズネ$$
「E-everyone, stay calm!
　The Federation Forces will surely come to save us!」

stage0004_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I-I don't know, but...
　a squad cosplaying as soldiers in helmets showed up,
　and grabbed $$恭子$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$...!」

stage0004_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「They snatched them and locked them
　inside the Mechanical Beast's capsule!」

stage0004_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$宗介$$!
　Get $$千鳥かなめ$$ somewhere safe!」

stage0004_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$かなめ$$
「W-wait!
　What about $$恭子$$ and the others!?」

stage0004_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$甲児$$
「It's all right!
　I'll definitely get everyone out!」

stage0004_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Word came in from the Quarter.
　They say it's already nearby.」

stage0004_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$アルト$$
「But if we provoke $$ブロッケン$$ carelessly,
　the hostages' lives will be in danger...!」

stage0004_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then what are we supposed to do!?」

stage0004_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's impossible alone!
　We need everyone working together here!」

stage0004_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アルト$$
「Tch!
　Letting his head get hot like that!」

stage0004_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Leave him be!
　Handling this situation comes first right now!」

stage0004_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hahahaha!
　There's nothing you can do, $$兜甲児$$!」

stage0004_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I've waited long for the day of revenge!
　Watch helplessly as your city burns,
　and regret your own powerlessness!」

stage0004_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Stop this!
　...Stop it! Just stop already!!」

stage0004_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hahahaha! Did you see that, $$兜甲児$$!?
　This is my tribute to Dr. Hell, our master,
　whom you struck down!」

stage0004_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「$$兜甲児$$, and $$弓$$'s daughter!」

stage0004_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブロッケン$$!
　Your grudge is with me, isn't it!
　Then don't drag innocent bystanders into this!」

stage0004_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nuhahaha!
　I'm not soft enough to fall for talk like that!」

stage0004_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Oh? Planning to resist?
　Then I'll crush the capsule with the hostages!」

stage0004_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「That's it!
　That's the voice I wanted to hear!
　Let me hear more of your screams!」

stage0004_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「$$兜甲児$$! And $$弓さやか$$!
　If you resist, count the hostages as dead!」

stage0004_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it!
　Damn you, $$ブロッケン$$!!」

stage0004_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nufufu... Does it frustrate you?
　It must be, mustn't it!」

stage0004_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「And I know something else!
　That Mazinger's Photon Power is running out!」

stage0004_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Seems you pushed it too hard in the $$再世戦争$$!
　Hahaha! Curse your own helplessness and Mazinger's!」

stage0004_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$甲児$$
「That $$ブロッケン$$...
　He's looked into Mazinger that deeply...」

stage0004_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm sorry, $$さやか$$...
　for dragging you into such a losing bet.」

stage0004_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$さやか$$
「Don't worry about me.
　With $$ビューナスＡ$$'s repair unit,
　I should be able to buy us some time.」

stage0004_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Do it, $$グロゴスＧ５$$, $$タロス像$$!
　Go play with the defenseless $$兜甲児$$!」

stage0004_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$n
「That guy... he knew the odds were against him,
　yet he still came out to save the hostages...」

stage0004_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$n
「And compared to him, I... can't do anything at all...」

stage0004_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hahahaha!
　The once-invincible $$マジンガーＺ$$ and $$兜甲児$$,
　what a pathetic sight!」

stage0004_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$甲児$$
「N-no good...
　At this rate, we're just waiting to die...!」

stage0004_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$甲児$$
「But there's nothing left to do!
　I... I can't save everyone!」

stage0004_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「That's right, $$兜甲児$$!
　With Mazinger's weapons, there's no way to attack
　Grogos without also destroying the capsule!」

stage0004_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Today, at least, curse Mazinger's power!」

stage0004_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$甲児$$
「If only I knew a way to stop that Mechanical Beast...!」

stage0004_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hm? Frustrated?
　Then let me make it even worse for you!」

stage0004_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Grogos has two control circuits in its chest!
　Strike both of them at the same time,
　and you might just stop Grogos!」

stage0004_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「But it's pointless!
　Mazinger could never manage such precise strikes,
　let alone hit two spots at once!」

stage0004_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Oops!
　Better pull Grogos back, just in case!」

stage0004_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Behold my meticulous command!
　You haven't got a chance in ten thousand!」

stage0004_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$甲児$$
「...It's true, Mazinger's weapons
　can't manage an attack that precise...」

stage0004_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$甲児$$
「But $$ブロッケン$$!
　My weapon... my strength isn't only Mazinger!」

stage0004_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「OK, $$甲児$$!
　Even $$アルト$$ would be shocked by that acting!」

stage0004_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I-impossible!
　Precision shots on two spots at once!?」

stage0004_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Mazinger's not your only enemy here!」

stage0004_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ボス$$
「$$ヌケ$$, $$ムチャ$$!
　While it's stopped, let's save every hostage!」

stage0004_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Ah, you fool!
　Stop it, you!!」

stage0004_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Like I'd let you interfere with $$ボス$$!」

stage0004_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「No! At this rate, my precious hostages...!」

stage0004_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$甲児$$
「Hating me made you forget your own men, your mistake!」

stage0004_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nguuh!
　The sniper, fine, but a buffoon like that...
　never crossed my mind from the start!」

stage0004_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ボス$$
「Shut up, Headless!
　Someday I'll make your head a rugby ball!」

stage0004_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「$$ボス$$, we gotta hurry!
　This thing's about to start moving again!」

stage0004_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「One more!
　Just the capsule with $$先生$$ left!」

stage0004_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Move, Grogos!
　If it comes to this, send just one to hell!」

stage0004_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
（...I'm powerless...
　even as someone's life is being taken right before me,
　I can't do anything...）

stage0004_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$n
（Even if I get my hands on $$ジェニオン$$, I... I...!）

stage0004_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「What's going on!?
　He crossed that distance in an instant!」

stage0004_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$さやか$$
「Right now we need to protect them and $$先生$$!」

stage0004_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$l!
　We need to run, quickly!」

stage0004_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain!
　$$ボスボロット$$ has rescued the hostages!
　It seems the last one was taken by $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0004_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$キャシー$$
「The recovered Skull 2 and $$ウルズ$$ 6
　are ready to sortie again.」

stage0004_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$甲児$$, $n...!
　Fall back and regroup for now!」

stage0004_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ボス$$
「I don't know what trick you pulled,
　but I'm impressed by your guts.」

stage0004_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ボス$$
「This $$ボス$$ himself will back you up!
　Go wild, however much you like!」

stage0004_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, hey, $$ブロッケン$$!
　Your cheap little scheme ends here!」

stage0004_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Damn you, $$兜甲児$$, you and your friends!」

stage0004_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$甲児$$
「For that dirty trick you pulled,
　Mazinger and I will make you regret it!」

stage0004_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Takeo General Company's in this too!」

stage0004_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Yes, President!
　We'll all do our very best!」

stage0004_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Remember this, $n!
　The enemy flagship has a system that
　controls their command chain!」

stage0004_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$オズマ$$
「By controlling the front line with it,
　the enemy attacks in perfect coordination!」

stage0004_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$マオ$$
「In short, take down their battleship
　and the whole lot of them fall apart.」

stage0004_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$n
「Got it!
　So hitting their ship first is the standard play?」

stage0004_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$l...!
　What in the world is going on!?」

stage0004_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$n
「I'll explain everything later!
　First, I have to deal with the enemy in front of us!」

stage0004_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$n
「$$先生$$, please stay right there
　on that panel and don't move!」

stage0004_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come, $$ブロッケン$$!
　I'll send you straight back to hell!!」

stage0004_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$郁絵$$
「President, the enemy's been wiped out.」

stage0004_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$厚井$$
「Damage to the city seems minimal too.」

stage0004_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Heh heh... first win for the Academy Defense Force!」

stage0004_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$甲児$$
（$$ブロッケン$$ was alive after all...
　Now that Dr. Hell's fallen, is there more behind this...）

stage0004_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But it's a promise.
　You're going to tell me everything.」

stage0004_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$スズネ$$
「About that day, about this robot...
　and about the people fighting alongside you.」

stage0004_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You made your move, $$兜甲児$$!」

stage0004_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「This is a warning!
　$$グロゴスＧ５$$, destroy one of the capsules!」

stage0004_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hahahahaha!
　Because of you, one of the capsules broke!」

stage0004_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「D-damn it!
　I can't afford to lose the Ghoul here!」

stage0004_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$甲児$$
「I won't let you escape, $$ブロッケン$$!」

stage0004_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「D-damn it!
　I can't afford to lose the Ghoul here!」

stage0004_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$甲児$$
「Give it up already, $$ブロッケン$$!」

stage0004_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「I will never forgive someone like you!!」

stage0004_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$n
「I'll hit you with everything I've got!」

stage0004_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$クラン$$
「What was that attack from the $$ジェニオン$$ just now!?」

stage0004_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ルカ$$
「I don't know...!
　At least, up until yesterday, it shouldn't
　have had an attack pattern like that!」

stage0004_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$n
「Even I... don't know what's going on...」

stage0004_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$n
「But the $$ジェニオン$$'s output
　spiked suddenly, so...」

stage0004_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$甲児$$
「That was one heck of a combo!
　Not bad yourself!」

stage0004_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$n
（If I have that power...
　I can keep fighting from here on...）

stage0004_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm fine, $$さやか$$.
　Everyone taken hostage is going through
　far worse than me...!」

stage0004_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$甲児$$
「Next to that, enduring their attacks
　is nothing at all!」

stage0004_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$甲児$$
「Get ready, Mechanical Beast Army!
　I'll unleash everything I've held back!」

stage0004_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even without the Big Bang Punch,
　Mazinger can still fight!」

stage0004_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$甲児$$
「The hostages' anger...
　Mazinger and I will unleash it for them!」

stage0004_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「$$兜甲児$$!
　You infuriating brat!」

stage0004_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　No matter how many times you come back,
　Mazinger and I won't let you have your way!」

stage0004_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll teach you Mazinger's terror
　all over again, down to your very bones!!」

stage0004_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「This is Takeo General Company's first new venture!
　Everyone, let's give it all we've got!」

stage0004_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$厚井$$
「We'll support Trider with the $$シャトル$$ too!」

stage0004_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Of course, once the job's done safely,
　I'll have some tasty snacks ready too!」

stage0004_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$木下$$
「So that being the case,
　let's live it up, live it up!」

stage0004_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「All right!
　Takeo General Company, commence attack!!」

stage0004_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You little brat!
　I've got more grudges against you than I can count!」

stage0004_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If we're talking grudges,
　I've got plenty of my own too!」

stage0004_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I especially won't forgive what you did today!
　I'll show you my anger!!」

stage0004_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nngh!
　Buzzing around as annoyingly as ever!」

stage0004_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$アルト$$
「Like a slowpoke could ever catch up to me!」

stage0004_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Are you trying to insult my Ghoul!?」

stage0004_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Insult, my ass!
　They took my new classmate and $$先生$$ hostage,
　and that's got me furious!」

stage0004_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$アルト$$
「Get ready!
　I'll knock that slow bomber right out of the sky!」

stage0004_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You think some measly AS
　is a match for my Ghoul!」

stage0004_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$宗介$$
「Those who boast on the battlefield do not live long.
　This is an absolute law, since ancient times.」

stage0004_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You villain!
　Taking hostages, how dare you play so dirty!」

stage0004_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Silence, brat!
　All that matters in war is winning!」

stage0004_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But you're going to lose!
　Cowardly deeds always come back on you!」

stage0004_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Do it, $$鉄人$$!
　Don't let him get away!」

stage0004_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But... even if you say that...!」

stage0004_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$n
「If you don't want to die, listen to what I say!」

stage0004_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$n
「But in return, I will protect $$先生$$ no matter what...!
　No matter what!」

stage0004_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「That machine isn't in the data!
　Could this be $$兜甲児$$'s new ally!」

stage0004_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「What!?
　You dare show such disrespect to $$ブロッケン伯爵$$...」

stage0004_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$n
「Someone like you, who thinks so little
　of human life, should vanish from this world!」

stage0004_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$さやか$$
「$$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　I'll make you regret that dirty trick!」

stage0004_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「If there's one thing I regret,
　it's not toying with you a little
　while you were helpless!」

stage0004_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Both you and your robot
　have quite the figure, after all.」

stage0004_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$さやか$$
「Enemy of all women!
　I will never forgive you!!」

stage0004_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You junk-heap robot!
　How dare you get in the way of my plan!」

stage0004_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ボス$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　It's your fault for forgetting I existed!」

stage0004_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「Doesn't saying that make you sad...?」

stage0004_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ボス$$
「Shut up!
　Fine, I'll take this anger out on $$ブロッケン$$!」

stage0004_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Wh-what, taking it out on me!?」

stage0004_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ボス$$
「You've got no right to say that to me,
　you resentful jerk!!」
